name: cmix
description: Data compression program with high compression ratio

repo.name: cmix
repo.description: cmix is a lossless data compression program aimed at optimizing compression ratio at the cost of high CPU/memory usage.

readme.summary: The README clearly explains what cmix is but lacks concrete usage examples, detailed installation steps, and practical quick-start guidance for compression tasks.
readme.top_issue: No basic usage examples showing how to actually compress or decompress a file with command-line syntax

injection_risks.description: User input is used to construct file paths, but it's not directly executed as a shell command
Dictionary path is used without validation, potentially leading to path traversal attacks

critical_findings: Potential path traversal attacks due to lack of input validation
Error messages may expose internal file paths or other sensitive information
security.summary: The code has some security concerns, including potential injection risks and lack of input validation, but no critical vulnerabilities were found.

common_complaints: Compilation failures with modern CPU architectures (SSE/SIMD instructions)
Segmentation faults and memory issues across different platforms
Build compatibility issues with different compilers and standards

communication.summary: The maintainer provides generally helpful and clear responses, showing patience with repeated questions and a good level of technical depth.
